description: This file defines a React component named SessionsByOrganization that renders a responsive bar chart visualizing session counts grouped by organization name. It imports charting components from 'recharts', theme functions, and color schemes, and includes internal functions for label truncation and custom tooltip rendering.

methods.name: truncateLabel
methods.description: Truncates a label string to a maximum length, appending an ellipsis if necessary.

methods.name: CustomTooltip
methods.description: A React functional component that renders a custom tooltip for the chart, displaying the full label and session count.
